items.title: Howard Mandel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: And Wes Montgomery. I wish I had caught the Half Note with Wynton Kelly.

ctx.x: Yeah. But I would have enjoyed that I think too. And Wes Montgomery. I wish I had caught the Half Note with Wynton Kelly. I would have really dug that.
Yeah. I know my favorite guy is Cannonball. And I wonder if you ever saw him live?
